column3: To rely on someone or something; to be determined by something.
To participate in an activity or event.
To have a friendly relationship with someone.
To use up all of something so that none is left.
To deal successfully with a difficult situation.
To be the property of someone; to be a member of a group.
To be made up of the stated parts.
To happen because of something.
To mention or speak about; to look at for information.
To make a formal request for a job, permission, etc.
To think that something or someone is good or acceptable.
To demand something firmly and refuse to accept otherwise.
To give most of one's attention to something.
To direct all of one's attention or effort to something.
To manage to do something one has tried to do.
To accept a proposal or say that one will do something.
To say that one is sorry for something.
To be sure that something exists or is good or right.
To feel that something or someone is important.
To imagine or hope for something one would like.
To get away from a place or situation.
To pay attention to a sound, a person, or advice.
To oppose or disapprove of something.
To take part in an activity or event.
To give money in exchange for something; to suffer for a mistake.
To watch, listen to, or think about something carefully.
To make oneself or something ready for an event.
To become well or normal again after an illness or difficulty.
To reply or react to something.
To use money or time for a particular purpose.
To look at something or someone for a long time.
To feel anxious about something.
To be going to do something very soon.
As stated by; in a way that agrees with.
As a result of; on account of.
In place of; rather than.
Without being prevented by; despite.
Caused by; because of.
Because of (often a good result).
A large number or amount of.
A large or sufficient amount or number of.
Beside; very close to.
As far as; until; dependent on the decision of.
To become or make someone happier.
To reach someone ahead; to bring oneself up to date.
To become accustomed to something.
